scope: Character column only. Farther-left15 words are loci1..15; running text begins at50. The stale ZL comment saying16..40 does not describe the complete current locus sequence.
layout_note: Original mirror shows the two left margin columns and irregular vertical spacing. The inner margin character column is read top to bottom; no wrap, collapsed gaps or alignment to one character per body line is assumed.
transcription_limitation: Some entries use multiple EVA components (e.g. sh, air); each full physical entry stays one item. Shared encoding is not proof of one underlying linguistic character.
prior_influence_note: ZL f66r.37 and .38 comments explicitly compare with f57v. Thus even the native source identification is not blind to the other page; sequence scores are a reserved calculation, not independent paleographic evidence.
